landing.tagline: A shared countdown timer for live events, synced across every screen.
landing.codeCardDesc: Join as a participant — no account needed.

login.descLogin: Log in to control your rooms from any device.
login.descSignup: Sign up to create and control rooms from any device.
login.notConfigured: Sign-in isn't configured in this environment yet.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Every room is free to view and join by code — no account needed. What follows only applies to creating and owning rooms.
pricing.roomsBullet1: Includes {free} participants, full event history, .xlsx export, and up to {segments} segments
pricing.roomsBullet2: Good for one event — once the event ends, that room is done. Your next event needs its own room.
pricing.participantsBullet1: Only if a room needs more than {free} participants
pricing.participantsBullet2: Buy a batch up front and use it across any of your rooms, whenever you need it
pricing.noCheckout: No self-serve checkout yet — message us on WhatsApp with how many rooms and/or extra participants you want and the account email to put them on, and we'll top up your balance.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.subtitle: Guides for running an event with Cue are coming soon.

dashboard.subtitle: Create a room and share the code, or join one someone shared with you.
dashboard.newRoomDesc: Set up your agenda — you can edit it later from the operator panel.
dashboard.joinDesc: Enter the room code the host shared with you.
dashboard.joinHint: You will be asked for your name so the room's host knows who's watching.
dashboard.runningDesc: Jump back into an event that's currently in progress.

myRooms.signInHint: Sign in to see every room linked to your account.
myRooms.creditsLine: {rooms, plural, one {# room credit} other {# room credits}} · {users, plural, one {# extra participant credit} other {# extra participant credits}} left.
myRooms.importTitle: Rooms on this browser aren't saved to your account
myRooms.importDesc: {count, plural, one {# room you created from this browser isn't linked yet — import it to control from any device.} other {# rooms you created from this browser aren't linked yet — import them to control from any device.}}
myRooms.noRooms: No rooms linked to your account yet — create one from the Dashboard.
myRooms.archivedCount: {count, plural, one {# archived room} other {# archived rooms}}

history.signInHint: Sign in to see every event across your rooms.
history.noRuns: No events recorded yet — history starts once you press Start on a segment and later end the event, in any of your rooms.

account.signInHint: Sign in to manage your account.
account.nameHint: Shown wherever you appear as a room's operator.

agendaList.empty: No segments yet — add one below.

joinGate.removedTitle: You were removed from this room
joinGate.joinDesc: Enter your name to see the timer.
joinGate.genericError: Something went wrong joining. Please try again.

missingToken.title: Missing operator link
missingToken.desc: Open this room using the operator link you received when you created it.

participantsPanel.removeDescOperator: Remove "{name}" from this room? They'll be sent back to the join screen and lose operator access immediately. They can rejoin with a name at any time — this doesn't block them.
participantsPanel.removeDescViewer: Remove "{name}" from this room? They'll be sent back to the join screen. They can rejoin with a name at any time — this doesn't block them.

segmentDialog.title: Edit segment
segmentDialog.desc: Changes apply the moment you save — everyone watching sees them.
segmentDialog.scheduledHint: Informational only — used to show how far ahead or behind schedule the event is running. Nothing starts automatically.
segmentDialog.notesPlaceholder: Optional — visible to the operator only

screen.notFoundDesc: Double-check the code or link and try again.
screen.promotedBanner: You've been made an operator — open panel
screen.wakeLockWarning: Screen may sleep — wake lock unavailable

control.title: Operator
control.claimError: Couldn't save this room — you need the room's original operator link, not a granted-access one.
control.claimPrompt: Save this room to your account for cross-device control and history.
control.messageHint: Nothing on screen. Screens get a banner at the top, and phones buzz if they support vibration (Android only — iPhones can't).
control.roomCodeHint: Room code — read aloud or typed into the "Join with code" tab on the dashboard
control.shareHint: Either way, whoever opens it enters their name and shows up below — you can grant them operator access if you want.
control.demotedDesc: The room's host took back control.
control.endEventDesc: This archives this event to History and stops the timer. Your agenda stays exactly as it is — you can run it again, and it'll be recorded as a new event.
control.switchDescRunning: "{current}" is still running. Switching to "{next}" will stop it and reset its progress to zero.
control.switchDescPaused: "{current}" is still paused partway through. Switching to "{next}" will stop it and reset its progress to zero.
control.deleteDescActive: Delete "{name}"? This can't be undone. It's the segment currently selected — deleting it will also stop the event.

historyRoom.loadError: Could not load history for this room.
historyRoom.noRuns: No events recorded yet — history starts once you press Start on a segment and later end the event.

gate.outOfRoomCredits: You're out of room credits. Buy more on the Pricing page to create another room.
gate.roomFull: This room is full — it allows {cap, plural, one {# participant} other {# participants}}.

gate.historyAnonBlocked: Event history isn't available for anonymous rooms — sign in before creating a room to get history.
gate.exportAnonBlocked: Exporting isn't available for anonymous rooms — sign in before creating a room to export.
gate.segmentsAnonCap: Anonymous rooms allow up to {cap, plural, one {# segment} other {# segments}} — sign in before creating a room for more.
gate.trimHintTrim: Trim your agenda and try again
gate.oneEventPerRoom: This room already ran its one event. Create a new room (spends a room credit) for your next one.
gate.signInToCreate: Sign in to create a room.
